description: Source code for PWM-driven LEDs driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing LED control via PWM signals including initialization, on/off, brightness, blinking, and power management.

methods.name: led_pwm_blink
methods.description: Sets the LED to blink with specified on/off delays using PWM.

methods.name: led_pwm_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the LED as a percentage.

methods.name: led_pwm_on
methods.description: Turns the LED on at full brightness.

methods.name: led_pwm_init
methods.description: Initializes the PWM LED device, checking readiness of PWM hardware.

methods.name: led_pwm_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for the PWM LEDs.
